notes: The Ethernet shield is stacked on top of the Arduino Uno (per the manual's note); the shield's pass-through header pins are modelled as joined+electrical to the matching Uno ports, and jumper wires plug into the shield's top sockets.
SPI wiring follows the circuit image and schematic: D13=SCK, D12=MOSI, D11=MISO (the code comment lists MOSI 11 / MISO 12, which conflicts; images are the authority).
DRDY goes to D6 and CSB to D7, as in the text and schematic (the schematic's crossed lines).
Sensor powered from the shield's 3.3V; common ground via the shield's Gnd pin (red and black wires).
The Ethernet cable to the network and the USB cable to the computer are not modelled as they are not drawn in the circuit; no breadboard is used.
The SCP1000 breakout's header pins are treated as header-pin ports that the jumper wire ends join onto.
